about: Every pre-registered experiment, for the Proof & audit page. Written by hand from docs/trackers/experiments.md and git (Nov 2); never computed at runtime. plan = the first commit whose experiments log has the entry; result = the first commit that added the result file. custody: 'plan_first' when git shows the plan committed before the result, 'same_commit' when they landed together (order not provable from git), 'not_run'. A test checks every file and commit here exists. bar = the decision rule as fixed in advance, copied from the experiments log.

experiments.question: Baseline: is there anything worth fixing in tool calling?
experiments.summary: Little headroom: 88.5% with 8 tools; only missing shop knowledge failed
experiments.note: An earlier trial run (arm-core_v1, 10:43) is in the plan's own commit.

experiments.question: 40 tools: direct, or Muse's own tool search?
experiments.summary: Muse's tool search was no better than direct calls, and slower and dearer

experiments.question: Business operations lab: does it show something new?
experiments.summary: Muse matched the optimum, but nothing new to show: dropped

experiments.question: Open weights (Muse Spark Open) against Muse Spark 1.3
experiments.summary: Within a point: 87.5% vs 88.5% with 8 tools, 86.5% vs 86.5% with 40; Open faster

experiments.question: Dispatch planning: where does the agent fail?
experiments.summary: Unwritten rules: 0% without them. This became the problem

experiments.question: Does it learn from history, and transfer to a second customer?
experiments.summary: Self-improvement and transfer shown; 0 leaks

experiments.question: Do gated lessons beat plain retrieval over raw history?
experiments.summary: No: on small clean data, raw history did as well (8/8 vs 7/8)

experiments.question: Learning at scale: what does mining find?
experiments.summary: Mining precision 73% against an 85% bar (repeat 0); learning changed behaviour and transfer worked (both met)

bar.text: Mining: pooled precision ≥ 0.85, recall ≥ 0.60, 0 trap rules admitted (repeat 0, T01 to T03). Also: learning changes behaviour, and cold-start transfer

experiments.question: Does a sharper evidence gate reach 85% precision?
experiments.summary: 83%, bar 85%; recall 74%, 0 traps

bar.text: pooled precision ≥ 0.85, recall ≥ 0.60, 0 trap rules admitted, on an unseen world

experiments.question: The same, confirmed on a second unseen world
experiments.summary: Precision 90%, recall 69%, 0 traps

bar.text: pooled precision ≥ 0.85, recall ≥ 0.60, 0 trap rules admitted, on a second unseen world

experiments.note: Plan and result were committed together, so git cannot show which came first.

experiments.question: Does practice make the agent better at using its tools?
experiments.summary: Already 100% on held-out questions: the patch was rightly rejected

experiments.question: Final benchmark on an unseen world
experiments.summary: Unwritten rules 35% to 90%; new company 33% to 100%

bar.text: Lessons: C − B ≥ 25 points with 0 unsafe drafts. Transfer: E − B ≥ 25 points with 0 pack leaks

experiments.note: The first run was interrupted and resumed; 65 of 102 runs kept from their log lines.

experiments.question: EXP-011 repeated 3 times on the shipped version
experiments.summary: Replicated 3 of 3: 48% to 90%, 33% to 100%, 0 unsafe

bar.text: EXP-011's bars, per repeat and pooled: C − B ≥ 25 points with 0 unsafe; E − B ≥ 25 points with 0 leaks

experiments.question: Do query tools and learned tools answer gap questions?
experiments.summary: Both rules missed: learned tools were never called (0/16)

experiments.question: The same, with general names for learned tools
experiments.summary: Used in 14 of 16; 20% fewer calls against a 30% bar

bar.text: Learned tools: calls ≤ 0.7 × the query arm's, and answers not worse

experiments.question: Does the team work as well as one Planner?
experiments.summary: Safe and within its bars; not more accurate. The learning round missed its bar

experiments.question: Does the whole team improve as it learns, and does each agent?
experiments.summary: Team 58.6% to 91.4%, unsafe 4 to 0 (3 of 5 bars met); no tools made, and Tool Forge's approved change made it worse (100% to 50%)

bar.text: S1 0 unsafe from s2 on; S2 lessons ≥ +25 points; S3 pack ≥ +25 points, 0 leaks; S4 a tool made, used on half the gap questions, gap no worse, cost ≤ 0.8×; S5 s4 no lower than s3 and one agent's own score up

experiments.note: First frozen on 2026-10-31 (59716e7) and not run; re-registered with Muse Spark 1.3 agents on the Meta API before any call (D-054).

experiments.question: Does EXP-011R hold on Muse Spark 1.3, the model judges use live?
experiments.summary: Replicated 3 of 3 on Spark 1.3: 45% to 90%, 33% to 100%, 0 unsafe

bar.text: EXP-011's bars, per repeat and pooled: C − B ≥ 25 points with 0 unsafe; E − B ≥ 25 points with 0 leaks; replicated if met pooled and in 2 of 3 repeats

experiments.question: Are learned tools used, and cheaper, on Muse Spark 1.3?
experiments.summary: No tools made on Spark 1.3 (0 of 16 used); it answered well without them

bar.text: Learned tools: calls ≤ 0.7 × the query arm's, and answers not worse; used on at least half the questions

experiments.question: Does learning get better as the company has more history?
experiments.summary: T01 mined from 30, 60, 90 days: recall 72.7% to 81.8% to 81.8%, precision 100%, 0 traps (none were proposed, so the gate's trap check was not tested)

bar.text: Recall at 90 days ≥ at 30 days; precision at 90 days ≥ 85%; 0 traps at every length

experiments.note: Plan and result committed together; the frozen plan file was written at 20:58, before the first model call (20:59).

experiments.question: With only Tool Forge writing SQL (the team), does Muse Spark 1.3 make learned tools, use them, and need fewer calls?
experiments.summary: Still no tools made (0 of 16 used). Tool Forge wrote all 47 queries and the query shapes halved, but no query served 3 different requests; the team took 7.9 calls a question against 3.3 for the Planner alone

bar.text: EXP-016's: calls ≤ 0.7 × the query arm's and answers not worse; learned tools used on at least half the questions; secondary: at least 1 tool made

experiments.note: Plan and result committed together; the frozen plan file was written at 07:25:01, before the first model call (07:25:07).

experiments.question: Does the team as it ships today (per-agent tools enforced, skills, supervised runs) hold up on Muse Spark 1.3?
experiments.summary: Planned 36 of 38 with 0 unsafe drafts and 100% routing, and no agent tried another agent's tool; but 10 of 16 data questions against a bar of 13 (one Planner: 15 and 16 of 16)

bar.text: 0 unsafe drafts; planning cases ≥ 34 of 38; data questions ≥ 13 of 16; routing ≥ 90%

experiments.question: Does the hosted demo's story (ask, learn, approve the gate rule, ask again) work end to end through the app's API?
experiments.summary: The 22 ft gate rule was proposed and held 3 of 3, and every second reply named it; but an approved rule left the earlier 32 ft draft in place, so a 22 ft draft was made in 1 of 3. Fixed in code, re-measured in EXP-022

bar.text: Gate rule held in ≥ 2 of 3; after approval 0 trucks over the limit and a draft in ≥ 2 of 3; no model errors

experiments.note: A first attempt was aborted by a harness bug (visitor ids the server rejects) after one live run ($0.08), before any result was read; re-frozen at 0cf1ecc.

experiments.question: After the fix (approving an enforced rule cancels the open drafts it forbids), does the demo's story end with a 22 ft draft?
experiments.summary: The gate rule was held 3 of 3; the old 32 ft draft was cancelled and the next plan drafted a 22 ft truck and named the rule in 2 of 3 (1 of 3 before the fix); 0 trucks over the limit

bar.text: EXP-021's: gate rule held in ≥ 2 of 3; after approval 0 trucks over the limit and a draft in ≥ 2 of 3; no model errors
